outcome: Maternal and fetal outcomes of pregnancy
cohort: Twenty women with primary systemic vasculitis, totaling 30 pregnancies, followed at a third-level referral center between 2009 and 2022.
finding: Vasculitis relapses during pregnancy and post-partum, alongside other pregnancy complications like preeclampsia, preterm birth, and low birthweight, are common in patients with systemic vasculitides, though most pregnancies result in a good outcome.
